name: icon
title: Icon library
description: 1,722 icon names with Cojeev micro-interactions, outline, duotone and organic treatments, built on Lucide geometry.

props.name: feedback
props.description: One-shot feedback from the nearest control. Disable when another owner animates this icon.

props.name: treatment
props.description: Optional Cojeev treatments; outline preserves the original glyph footprint.

props.name: tone
props.description: Accent layer color. Outline remains currentColor for readable action icons.

props.name: feedbackDuration
props.description: Bounded timing for native control feedback; AnimatedIcon adds explicit preset motion.
